document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Chapters 1–5 — Object Relationships

structural_relationships.subject: PrimaryBeam
detailing_consequence: Top support bars of primary beam placed above secondary beam bars
Bottom span bars of primary beam stop short of column face
Link hanger bars stop short of column face
Continuity through column provided by main support bars + bottom support bars

structural_relationships.subject: PrimaryBeam
detailing_consequence: Primary beam top support bars placed above secondary beam top bars
Layers must pass over each other with correct cover to upper and lower layers
Check secondary beam increased top cover does not reduce lever arm unsatisfactorily

structural_relationships.subject: Beam
detailing_consequence: U-bars placed into column reinforcement, as close to far face of column as possible
OR L-bars cast into lower column before beam cage placed

structural_relationships.subject: Slab
detailing_consequence: Cover over beam reinforcement must be sufficient for slab top steel to pass over beam with correct cover

structural_relationships.subject: LongitudinalBar
structural_relationships.context: bottom span bars and link hanger bars in preferred (flexible) detailing method

structural_relationships.subject: ColumnBar
structural_relationships.note: Column bars go straight through junction

structural_relationships.subject: Link
constraints: Sufficient space between links for concrete and vibrator: 75mm per 300mm beam width
Returned legs of link must be included in actual space calculation
Free height of link limited to 400mm by cross ties at 1000mm centres

structural_relationships.subject: Hole
structural_relationships.consequence: Additional trimming reinforcement required around hole; hole must be shown on rebar drawing

structural_relationships.subject: BarSchedule
structural_relationships.rule: Each schedule references only one drawing; schedule reference number + bar mark form unique combination

structural_relationships.subject: BarMark
structural_relationships.rule: Bar mark must not repeat within same member name; every bar mark must have a member name
